body.name: Three-context pin-resistant separation family
body.construction: For each \(n\geq1\), use binary \(W^{(n)}\), factual cell \((S,T,X_1,\ldots,X_n,Y)=(0,0,0,\ldots,0,0)\), contexts \(\mathcal H_n^{\mathrm{sep}}\), and conjunction \(\gamma_n^{\mathrm{sep}}\). This conjunction is already predecessor-normal and satisfies \(\mathsf N(\gamma_n^{\mathrm{sep}})=\gamma_n^{\mathrm{sep}}\).
